summary: Dispute over specific performance of an agreement to sell dated 07.08.2005; trial court decreed performance with 25% enhanced consideration; High Court set aside decree relying on Section 20 of Specific Relief Act, holding enhancement unjustified; appellant challenged reversal; key issues: readiness and willingness of plaintiff, equity under Section 20, disputed 'forced' sale due to medical emergency; Supreme Court upheld trial court’s decree, finding plaintiff ready and willing, and enhancement not erroneous.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 20 of the Specific Relief Act
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment of High Court set aside; decree for specific performance reinstated with direction to pay enhanced consideration as ordered by trial court.
